label: rare late-original/delimiter firing, strongest on e in m/i-initial sequences
explanation: Fires only at original positions 4-8 and at the <DEL> step (never in the copy phase), mostly on the last 1-3 originals of long (L>=7) sequences. Within that window it is very sparse (~0.2% of eligible steps). Enriched for sequences starting with m (63% of mass) or i, with g/b early in the prefix, and for input e (41% of mass, incl. the max activation). No predicate tried got past F1 ~0.19: the location-only window has ~100% recall at 0.2% precision, and adding first-token/e conditions loses most recall. The reported predicate captures only the strongest sub-pattern.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: orig0=m (+6.93), orig0=i (+4.54), prev_tok=0 (+4.47), orig2=g (+4.04), orig1=i (+3.75), orig3=g (+3.12). Lower it: phase=2 (-4.73), t=3 (-3.31), prev3_tok=- (-3.28), t=4 (-3.10).
